### Bible Pathways 02/09/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-02-or-09-or-2002-1127438.html
Passage: Leviticus 22:2-3
Points:
- Priests who became ceremonially defiled were barred from handling sacred food until cleansed and obedient.
- Approaching consecrated offerings in an unclean state risked divine judgment and separation from God's presence.
- Religious service, gifts, or sacrifices are unacceptable to God when offered while living in defilement.
- Believers must actively guard their minds, actions, and conduct to walk in obedience to Christ.
